Sam R.: hey hi everyone — first week here. following the k8s onboarding but `kubectl get pods -n dev-sandbox` gives Forbidden. I set context to redwood-staging-eu per the doc. any quick checks?

Onboarding Bot: Welcome Sam! Make sure you completed SSO and ran redwoodctl sync-kubeconfig. See: https://intranet.redwood/dev-onboarding#k8s. If you still have issues, @devex can help.

Sam R.: ran `redwoodctl login --sso` already. current-context shows redwood-staging-eu. output:

```
kubectl config current-context
# => redwood-staging-eu
kubectl get pods -n dev-sandbox
# Error from server (Forbidden): pods is forbidden: User "system:anonymous" cannot list resource "pods" in the namespace "dev-sandbox"
```

Alex H.: that anonymous error usually means kubectl is hitting the API without credentials (wrong kubeconfig or env). Two quick checks: 1) `echo $KUBECONFIG` (are you merging multiple kubeconfigs?) 2) `kubectl config view --minify --raw` (mask tokens) to see which user entry is active.

Sam R.: `echo $KUBECONFIG` -> `/home/sam/.kube/config:/home/sam/.kube/workspace-config` (I forgot I had a workspace file).

Alex H.: yep that's it. when KUBECONFIG is multiple files, the current-context can come from a file that doesn't have creds. Either unset KUBECONFIG or point it to the synced config. Try:

```
unset KUBECONFIG
redwoodctl sync-kubeconfig --cluster=redwood-staging-eu
kubectl config use-context redwood-staging-eu
kubectl auth can-i get pods -n dev-sandbox
```

Sam R.: ran the commands. `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n dev-sandbox` -> "no" now. INFRA ticket INFRA-8592 created by infra-bot earlier.

infra-bot: INFRA-8592: new-hire RBAC check for samr. Current status: samr not in group "redwood:devs". Please confirm GitHub org membership and add GH handle to ticket.

Sam R.: added GH handle to INFRA-8592.

Alex H.: infra team usually binds group `redwood:devs` to namespace role `dev-sandbox:dev`. While they add you, you can `kubectl -n dev-sandbox get pods --as=system:serviceaccount:dev-sandbox:ci-bot` if infra gives temporary SA access, but prefer waiting for group binding.

infra-bot: Updated INFRA-8592: added rolebinding `namespace=dev-sandbox role=edit subject=group:redwood:devs` — pending sync. Expected completion ~10-30m.

Sam R.: ~15m later: ran `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n dev-sandbox` -> "yes". `kubectl get pods -n dev-sandbox` lists pods now. :relieved:

Alex H.: nice. Quick tips for first-week safety: 1) avoid `kubectl delete --all` without namespace. 2) use `--dry-run=client` for dangerous commands. 3) `kubectl config view --flatten --minify` is helpful to inspect the exact user/token for the current context.

Sam R.: thanks all! I'll update my personal notes and the onboarding doc suggestion: call out KUBECONFIG merging and the INFRA ticket flow.

Alex H.: filed a tiny doc edit PR referencing INFRA-8592. welcome aboard again! :tada:
